katie: @channel :loudspeaker: Heads up — we’re opening a small MI300E edge micro-pool in Milwaukee (MKE) for Dedicated. This is a targeted capacity wave to support low-latency regional workloads and some early customer pilots. Please read the rollout notes below and follow reservation guidance.

capacity-bot: Automated: pool created -> mke-mi300e-edge-1 (3x MI300E nodes). Tag: region=mke, pool_type=edge, gpu=mi300e.

raj: Nice — what's the burst policy for the initial warm-up?

katie: Initial burst window is 09:00-11:00 CDT daily for the next 7 days. During warm-up we'll allow higher burst headroom to populate caches and gather perf telemetry. After that we'll move to a 2-hour rotational burst alignment based on fairshare.

mike: Operational notes: if you have existing reservations in nearby zones, expect automatic soft-fallbacks to compatible pools if MKE is out of capacity. Please avoid hard pinning to mke-mi300e-edge-1 during the first 48h.

ana: tiny correction — CLI sample for reservations:
```
redwood reserve create --pool mke-mi300e-edge-1 --qty 2 --start 2026-04-15T09:00:00-05:00 --duration 4h
```
Use `--flex` to mark non-guaranteed (burst) reservations.

sanjay: For cost centers: this pool will be billed at the "edge/mi300e" rate tier. If you need committed capacity, open a dedicated request to capacity@redwood.ai — we can offer short-term reserved buckets.

katie: Docs link: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/pools#mke-mi300e (contains pool id, tagging rules, and SLOs). Also a short checklist:
- tag routes with region=mke if you want affinity
- avoid strict version pinning on model variants for first 72h
- enable telemetry sampling flag `redwood.telemetry.edge_sampling=true`

raj: Any special security/compliance notes for MKE?

mike: No extra compliance controls. Private deployments still follow customer KMS/HSM. Edge pools inherit standard audit logging.

ana: Quick ops snippet to check pool health:
```
# pool status
redwood pool status mke-mi300e-edge-1
# example output (brief):
# state: ready
# nodes: 3
# active_reservations: 0
```

katie: tl;dr: small MI300E edge pool in Milwaukee is live, warm-up burst window 09:00-11:00 CDT for 7 days, follow reservation guidance and tagging. Ping me or @mike for migration issues. :rocket:

capacity-bot: Reminder queued: will post utilization summary tomorrow 09:05 CDT for the warm-up window.
